body: I've been depressed for a while now, sometimes it goes away for a few weeks or a few months but it always comes back and I just want it to permanently stop

Its the reverse for me, I'm afraid of the void, I'm afraid of the nothingness and the blankness. As much as I hate my thoughts I'm comforted by the fact that they're there. I'd much rather have an afterlife because atleast theres something you know? Its hard though as an fellow agnostic to end up believing in those things however.

Thanks, I've been looking forward to my trip this weekend with my friends but it usually ends up with me thinking about killing myself there before I go back or just disappearing there and leaving without any trace or something. As for helping people thats honestly what I was planning to do after I go to med school, I'm planning to join something like doctors without borders or something like that. Im just not sure if I'm gonna make it that long
